1. Purpose

This questionnaire is used by [Your Company Name] to evaluate the security, privacy, and compliance posture of prospective vendors and sub-processors before onboarding. All vendors that will process personal data on behalf of [Your Company Name] must complete this assessment.

When to use this template:

  • Evaluating a new SaaS vendor or sub-processor
  • Renewing an existing vendor relationship (annually)
  • Vendor undergoes a material change (acquisition, breach, new data processing)
  • Adding a new integration that processes personal data

7.3 Risk Classification

Overall Score (%)Risk LevelDecision

50-69%High RiskEscalate to Privacy Steering Committee — additional controls required
< 50%Critical RiskDo not proceed — vendor does not meet minimum requirements

7.4 Mandatory Requirements (Hard Fails)

The following are non-negotiable. A score of 0 on any of these results in automatic rejection:

  • S1 — Data must be encrypted at rest
  • S2 — Data must be encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+)
  • S13 — Must have a documented incident response plan
  • S14 — Breach notification within 72 hours
  • P2 — Must process data only as instructed
  • C8 — Must sign a DPA

8. Assessment Workflow

1. Business owner submits vendor request
     ↓
2. DPO sends this questionnaire to vendor
     ↓
3. Vendor completes and returns with evidence
     ↓
4. DPO scores responses and classifies risk
     ↓
5a. Low/Medium Risk → DPO approves (with conditions if medium)
5b. High Risk → Privacy Steering Committee review
5c. Critical Risk → Rejected
     ↓
6. DPA executed, vendor added to sub-processor list
     ↓
7. Annual reassessment scheduled
